name: eye-lash-blink-follow
treatment: T2b-selective-detach-drop+A3 (lash-tick tsk_0a4a6ccf5ebb0da0; supersedes the T2 blanket lower-drop, which hid all lower lashes)
t2bRule: drop a lower-lash card iff tipDrop (lid-margin-loop y at card x minus card tip y) > med+2.0*MAD or card length > med+2.5*MAD per side; loop = body eye-opening boundary, per-side 3mm x-bins, min-y vert per bin

settledVerdict.T1: FAILED: rigid alpha-card alignment rides 17mm into brow; recorded as failed treatment
settledVerdict.T2: WORKED: thin strand mesh, drop faces with any vert y<1.546
settledVerdict.A3: WORKED: lid-morph transfer, nearest SAME-SIDE MOVING body vert, |d|>0.05mm, nn 2.0mm
settledVerdict.G2: closure lash centroid 5.9/6.0mm vs lid margin 2.4/2.4mm, renders attached

licence.header: Copyright Data Collection AB; eyelashes01.mhclo released CC0 September 2020. No texture; strands opaque near-black.

gates.failClosed: exactly one /eyelash/i mesh or throw; known-bad input GLB (0 lash targets measured) fails RED
gates.blinkFollow: eye-*-closure morph moves lash lid-margin verts count>0, same direction, >=80% lid travel
gates.coverage: transfer reports per-side nn distance and moving-pool size
